channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Walk (330 Berry St)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Walk (330 Berry St) (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Walk (330 Berry St): The Mission Walk pages now say that SocketSite reported 131 below-market condos at 330 and 335 Berry St in 2008, while a condo listing site counts 41 and 39 units in the two buildings (80 in all); the sources are not reconciled.
item.description: The Mission Walk pages now say that SocketSite reported 131 below-market condos at 330 and 335 Berry St in 2008, while a condo listing site counts 41 and 39 units in the two buildings (80 in all); the sources are not reconciled. Source: SocketSite, 2008-10-27 (socketsite.com/archives/2008/10/mission_walk_330335_berry_applications_now_available_du.html); San Francisco Condo Market, 330 and 335 Berry St (sanfranciscocondomarket.com/building/330-berry-st, /335-berry-st); Mayor's Office of Housing / OCII memo, 2023-10-20.

item.title: Correction · Mission Walk (330 Berry St): The summary said the condos were built under the Redevelopment Agency's Affordable Homeownership Program and allocated by a January 2009 lottery; the SocketSite post only announces 131 BMR condos and a scheduled lottery, so the summary now says that. The map shape's sourcing now states that about two thirds of the shape is an extension added in this project's own mapping rather than a real building footprint, and the out-of-date 'opening year and unit count not confirmed' note now cites 2009 and 41 units from the record's own sources. The NAIP photo credit now names the Farm Production and Conservation Business Center.
item.description: The summary said the condos were built under the Redevelopment Agency's Affordable Homeownership Program and allocated by a January 2009 lottery; the SocketSite post only announces 131 BMR condos and a scheduled lottery, so the summary now says that. The NAIP photo credit now names the Farm Production and Conservation Business Center. Source: SocketSite, 2008-10-27 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2008/10/mission_walk_330335_berry_applications_now_available_du.html); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, 330 Berry St (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?block=8704&lot=278); San Francisco Condo Market, 330 Berry St (https://www.sanfranciscocondomarket.com/building/330-berry-st); USDA NAIP imagery catalog record (https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/national-agriculture-imagery-program-naip-imagery).
